telegram.heading: Telegram
telegram.subline: Connect your Telegram, then join your EZ Trade signal groups.
telegram.step1Body: Press Generate to create a one-time code, then send it to our bot. Your first message links your Telegram to EZ Trade.
telegram.step2Body: Once you're connected, join your signal group in one tap below.
telegram.notConnectedBody: Generate your one-time code and send it to {bot} on Telegram. This page updates the moment it links.
telegram.connectInstructions: Open {bot} and send it this exact message:
telegram.waitingForConnect: Waiting for your message to {bot}… this updates automatically.
telegram.copyFailed: Couldn't copy - select the command above and copy manually.
telegram.disconnectConfirmBody: You'll need a new code to reconnect. Your membership in any Telegram group stays until you leave it there.
telegram.groupsLockedHint: Connect your Telegram above to join your groups.
telegram.noGroups: No groups available yet. Connect a broker to unlock group access.
telegram.joinInstructions: Send this to {bot} to get your private invite:
telegram.leftGroup: You left this group - tap Join to get a new invite.
telegram.alreadyJoined: You're already in this group on Telegram.
telegram.noAccess: You don't have active access to this group yet.
telegram.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
telegram.groupDescEztrade: Live trade calls and analysis straight from the EZ Trade desk.
telegram.groupDescSilver: The Aurex room - higher-tier signals and sharper market reads.
telegram.groupDescDefault: Signals and trade calls, posted live as they happen.
telegram.stepConnectBody: Verify your Telegram with EZ Trade so the bot can DM your private invite.
telegram.stepJoinBody: Generate a code, send it to {bot}, and it DMs you a one-time invite.
telegram.stepGenBody: Mint a one-time code for your invite - it's good for 15 minutes.
telegram.stepSendBody: Open {bot} and hit Start - your code goes with it. The bot verifies you and DMs your one-time invite link in the chat.
telegram.waitingForInvite: Waiting for {bot} to DM your invite…
telegram.verifyIntro: The platform verifies your Telegram and gives you a one-time link to the {group} Group through the {botName} ({bot}).
telegram.verifyCode: The bot verifies a one-time code sent to it.
telegram.verifyHow: You can either open {bot} and paste the code manually, or just tap the button below.
telegram.verifyCopyLead: Copy the code below and send it to
telegram.verifyCopyTail: - it also starts the bot for you. Or just tap the button below to open the bot with your code already attached.
